570 
OCTOBER 29, 2026 
 
The special meeting of the City Council was held on Thursday, October 29, 2026 in Meeting 
Room 3-1, 111 North Main Street at 12:10 p.m.  Present were:  Mayor Zoppo-Sassu and Council 
Member Kelley.  Present by videoconference:  Council Member Tyler.  Present via telephone:  
Council Members Dickau, Hahn, Rosengren, Seymour. 
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
 Mayor Zoppo-Sassu called the special meeting to order at 12:10 p.m.  Technical issues with 
the videoconference link delayed the start time of the meeting. 
 
2. YOUTH SPORTS GRANT PROGRAM APPROVALS 
 
 Communication received from Grants Administrator Leger. 
 
 On motion of Council Member Rosengren and seconded by Council Member Seymour, it 
was unanimously voted:  To approve a resolution authorizing the Mayor or Acting Mayor to sign any 
and all documents on behalf of the City related to the application and acceptance of a Youth Sports 
Grant, on behalf of the Boys and Girls Club of the City of Bristol; and to waive the reading of said 
resolution. 
 
The Resolution reads as follows –  
RESOLVED, that the Bristol City Council hereby authorizes the Mayor or Acting Mayor to 
sign any and all documents on behalf of the City of Bristol related to the application for and 
acceptance of a Youth Sports Grant, on behalf of the Boys & Girls Club of the City of Bristol 
(a non-profit organization), in the amount of up to $225,625 for the renovation and outfitting 
of the relocated Future Champions Gymnastics Regional Studio at 231 Century Drive in 
Bristol; and 
 
FURTHER RESOLVED, that Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu is hereby authorized to enter into 
and execute any and all agreements, contracts and documents necessary to obtain said 2026 
OPM Youth Sports Grant with the State of Connecticut. 
 
AND IT IS FURTHER CERTIFIED that Ellen Zoppo-Sassu is the Mayor of the City of 
Bristol, and has held that office since November 10, 2025. 
 
A roll call vote was taken. 
YES    NO   ABSTAIN 
Council Member Dickau         
“             ”            Hahn 
“             ”            Kelley 
“             ”            Rosengren  
“             ”            Seymour  
“    ”     Tyler 
Mayor Zoppo-Sassu 
 
RESOLUTION ADOPTED: YES – 7; NO – 0; ABSTAIN – 0.
571 
OCTOBER 29, 2026 
 
 On motion of Council Member Hahn and seconded by Council Member Rosengren, it was 
unanimously voted to bring the same grant to the table for the Bell City Broncos based on an email 
received from the team at 11:31 a.m. on October 29, 2026. 
 
 On motion of Council Member Rosengren and seconded by Council Member Seymour, it was 
unanimously voted:  To approve a resolution authorizing the Mayor or Acting Mayor to sign any and 
all documents on behalf of the City related to the application and acceptance of a Youth Sports Grant, 
on behalf of the Bell City Broncos of the City of Bristol; and to waive the reading of said resolution. 
 
 Mayor Zoppo-Sassu explained that all the sports teams in Bristol were given the opportunity 
to apply for this grant, but the Boys and Girls Club and the Bell City Broncos were the only two 
entities to move forward with the application. 
 
The Resolution reads as follows –  
 
RESOLVED, that the Bristol City Council hereby authorizes the Mayor or Acting Mayor to 
sign any and all documents on behalf of the City of Bristol related to the application for and 
acceptance of a Youth Sports Grant, on behalf of the Bell City Broncos of the City of Bristol; 
and 
 
FURTHER RESOLVED, that Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu is hereby authorized to enter into 
and execute any and all agreements, contracts and documents necessary to obtain said 2026 
OPM Youth Sports Grant with the State of Connecticut. 
 
AND IT IS FURTHER CERTIFIED that Ellen Zoppo-Sassu is the Mayor of the City of 
Bristol, and has held that office since November 10, 2025. 
 
A roll call vote was taken. 
 YES    NO   ABSTAIN 
Council Member Dickau         
“             ”            Hahn 
“             ”            Kelley 
“             ”            Rosengren  
“             ”            Seymour  
“    ”     Tyler 
Mayor Zoppo-Sassu 
 
RESOLUTION ADOPTED: YES – 7; NO – 0; ABSTAIN – 0. 
 
3. ADJOURNMENT 
 
At 12:14 p.m., on motion of Council Member Rosengren and seconded by Council Member 
Hahn, it was unanimously voted:  To adjourn.
